d: The Heavy Driver (HIAB Operator) is responsible for the safe operation of heavy vehicles equipped with a HIAB (truck-mounted hydraulic crane) to transport, load, unload, and position materials, equipment, and machinery. The role ensures compliance with road traffic regulations, lifting safety requirements, and company HSE standards while maintaining assigned vehicles and equipment in a safe and serviceable condition.
q: Basic Lifting and Rigging certification is an advantage.
Minimum 3 years of experience as a Heavy Driver.
Minimum 2 years of experience operating HIAB or truck-mounted cranes.
Experience in construction, utilities, logistics, industrial, or maintenance operations preferred.
Knowledge of heavy vehicle operation and road safety regulations.
Proficiency in HIAB crane operation and safe lifting practices.
Ability to inspect vehicles, cranes, and lifting accessories.
Basic mechanical knowledge of vehicles and hydraulic systems.
Strong commitment to safety and quality standards.
Ability to work under pressure and meet operational deadlines.
r: li
Operate heavy vehicles and HIAB cranes safely and efficiently.
li
Transport materials, equipment, and machinery to designated locations.
li
Perform loading, unloading, and lifting operations in accordance with approved safety procedures.
li
Conduct pre-trip, post-trip, and daily inspections of vehicles, cranes, and lifting accessories.
li
Ensure loads are secured properly before transportation.
li
Follow traffic laws, company policies, and HSE requirements at all times.
li
Inspect lifting gear and report any defects or unsafe conditions immediately.
li
Maintain accurate records of trips, fuel usage, inspections, and deliveries.
li
Coordinate with supervisors, riggers, and site personnel during lifting operations.
li
Report accidents, incidents, breakdowns, and maintenance requirements promptly.
li
Maintain cleanliness and good housekeeping of assigned vehicles and equipment.
li
Support emergency transportation and lifting requirements as directed.

d: The Network Engineer helps maintain smooth operation of multi-user computer systems, including coordination with network administrators. Develops and monitors policies and standards for allocation related to the use of computing resources. Provides on-going operations and maintenance of Information Technology (IT) equipment and software, sets up administrator and service accounts, system performance tuning, update installations, and maintenance of system configuration/installation documentation. Makes recommendations to purchase hardware and software, coordinates installation and provides backup recovery. Interacts with users and evaluates vendor products.
Participate in daily briefing with the end-user to provide status of the systems
Perform on-site System Administration support to the end-user personnel and assist the end-user engineers with administering the system
Perform System Administration tasks for routine, emergency, test and exercise events in accordance with Technical Manuals, Operating Instructions, and checklists.
Perform user account maintenance to include the creation, management, and deletion of user and group accounts, profiles, and policies.
Perform On-The-Job-Training (OJT) and one-on-one assistance on the systems
Perform active monitoring of mission systems’ operational performance and link status to detect issues that may cause disruption of services

Perform data collection (including application, system, and security logs) of any unexpected service disruption and upon request provide data to the end-user to support deficiency resolution and post event forensics.
Perform error detection and fault correction of the systems
Perform backups and archive of the systems in accordance with Technical Manuals, Operating Instructions, and checklists.
Perform recovery and restoration of the systems in accordance with Technical Manuals, Operating Instructions, and checklists.
Perform startup, reboots, and shutdown of the systems in accordance with Technical Manuals, Operating Instructions, and checklists.
Record scheduled and unscheduled maintenance activities using the approved tracking system.
Support remote site maintenance activities to include scheduled and corrective actions
Perform troubleshooting and resolution of emergent system issues
Perform technical assistance, guidance and on job training to end-user engineers in identifying system problems, analysis, system coding and test verification
Perform technical assistance in documentation and management of system problem reports.
Support similar OM&S activities for OPs and Lab environments
q: Bachelors degree (BS/BA) in IT, Information Security, Computer Science, Computer Systems Engineering or MIS related field.
Ability to work well in a team environment
Ability to prioritise tasks and manage own time to meet program needs
Good IT skills in a range of SW packages would be an advantage
Knowledge of RedHat Linux and Unix Operating system
Knowledge of Network Interfaces, Addressing, and naming services operation
Knowledge of Computing and Networking Security Management Processes
Knowledge of Red Hat Identity Management (IdM)
